name: cbr-provider
description: CBR's protocol provider. Claims only what it implements: core/1 with core.events, core.grants, core.capabilities, core.events.backpressure and core.effects, evidence/1 with evidence.manifests, evidence.retention_control and evidence.work_binding, and the conformance-only core-test/1, over stdio, with the clock.file and evidence.store test controls. Run with --repo pointing at vendor/protocol/v0.1.0, which holds the pinned schemas and fixtures; the launch path is relative to that so this descriptor carries no machine-specific path. Build the binary first: cargo build --workspace.
